comments.author: antoniofrighetto
comments.body:
May be fixed upstream (https://godbolt.org/z/fP9hKjfrM)? `llc` trunk lowers `f` to the following:
```asm
f:                                      // @f
	.cfi_startproc
// %bb.0:
	orr	x8, x0, #0x1
	add	x8, x8, x0
	subs	x10, x1, x8
	subs	x8, x10, #0
	mov	x8, #-9223372036854775808       // =0x8000000000000000
	cinv	x8, x8, ge
	lsl	x9, x10, #1
	subs	x10, x10, x9, asr #1
	csel	x0, x8, x9, ne
	ret
```
`x0` is set to `0x7fffffffffffffff`.

comments.author: davemgreen
comments.body: From what I can tell there is a combine in the machinecombiner that is reassociating add/sub. It should be dropping the nsw flags but doesn't, which allows AArch64InstrInfo::substituteCmpToZero to remove the condition even with them using the V condition flag. This was added in D124564, and it looks like the code at the end of AArch64InstrInfo::genAlternativeCodeSequence might be the part incorrectly setting the flags.
